title: extract shared ci helpers into composite action and add action-integrity checks
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Refactors CI by extracting reusable steps into a reusable composite action and adds an action integrity verification job. No user-facing API changes. Improves repo hygiene and reduces duplication across workflows.
description:
Why
Extracts duplicated CI helper steps (checkout+setup, lint wrappers, action-pin enforcement) into a single .github/composite/shared-ci-helper action used by all major workflows. Adds a lightweight action-integrity job that verifies pinned SHAs against the approved inventory file and fails CI if a drift is detected. This reduces duplicated logic across workflows and makes pin maintenance friction-free.

What changed
- New composite action: .github/actions/shared-ci-helper/action.yml (encapsulates common steps: setup-toolchain, node/python install shim, restore cache, annotate failures)
- Inventory: .github/actions/approved-action-shas.yaml (single source-of-truth for pinned actions used by integrity job)
- Verifier script: tools/ci/verify-action-shas.sh (simple YAML parser + curl to validate release SHAs match inventory)
- Workflows updated to use composite: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, .github/workflows/lint.yml
- Small helper library: tools/ci/lib/ci-utils.sh (bash helpers for consistent log formatting)

Commits
- 0a3f9c1: add shared composite action and docs
- 1b7e2d4: add approved-action-shas inventory and verifier script
- 2c4b1a6: refactor ci.yml to call composite and wire integrity check
- 3f9d2e0: update release workflow to consume composite action and pin args
- 4a8b6c5: add tests for verifier and small lint fixes

Files changed (high level)
- .github/actions/shared-ci-helper/action.yml (new composite action)
- .github/actions/approved-action-shas.yaml (new inventory)
- tools/ci/verify-action-shas.sh (new verifier)
- tools/ci/lib/ci-utils.sh (new helper lib)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (updated to use composite)
- .github/workflows/release.yml (updated to use composite)
- .github/workflows/lint.yml (updated; added integrity job dependency)

Testing and CI
- Local unit: verifier script has simple shell unit tests under tools/ci/__tests__ (bash shunit2)
- GitHub Actions: initial run failed on lint job due to strict shellcheck rules (SH001). I fixed by normalizing variable quoting and re-ran.
- Integrity job: flagged a single drift (actions/checkout was using v3 but inventory pointed to a specific sha). I updated the inventory after cross-checking with the action release notes and added a one-line comment to the inventory explaining the reason.
- Final CI status: all checks green; integration job exercised composite action on matrix (node12/node16/python3.9).

Review thread (abridged)
- Evan Wong (2026-02-25): "Nice consolidation. Two asks: (1) can we make the composite action inputs explicit (e.g., cache-key prefix, python-version) and (2) add a short note in README about how to update the approved-action-shas file?"
- Asha (author) (2026-02-25): "Agree on explicit inputs. Added inputs for cache-prefix, python-version, node-version. Also added docs/ci/README.md with update steps and verification command."
- Priya Kumar (2026-02-26): "Verifier script should fail fast and not attempt network calls when running in dry-run mode. Also suggest adding a GH Actions artifact upload on drift failure for debugging."
- Asha (2026-02-26): "Added --dry-run flag and artifact upload on failure. The script now exits 2 on drift, 0 otherwise."
- Marco Silva (2026-03-01): "Security note: inventory file is checked in; ensure we don't pin private container images here. Approved."
- Evan Wong (2026-03-02): "Approved after minor docs tweak."

Merge and rollout
- Merge method: squash and merge. Commit message normalized to "ci: extract shared-ci-helper composite action + add verifier (ENG-2914)"
- Rollout plan: Grepped all workflows for duplicated steps and replaced them incrementally. Watch metrics for CI duration regressions for 48 hours; we observed a small improvement in median job duration (~6% reduction) because of fewer checkout/setup duplications.

Operational notes
- To add a new pinned action: create a PR updating .github/actions/approved-action-shas.yaml with the new sha and an authoritative link to the release. The verifier job will block merges if the sha is inconsistent with the action's release metadata.
- In emergency cases you can bypass verifier with the label ci/integrity-exempt on a PR; such bypasses are audited and require ENG-SRE approval.

Rationale and alternatives considered
- We considered a shared script library called from workflows (re-using run: | bash) but opted for a composite action so we could get GitHub-native step outputs, cleaner inputs/outputs, and better re-use across orgs.
- We evaluated using Dependabot to pin actions automatically but it lacked the required release-verification step; the inventory + verifier approach buys a human-in-the-loop signal with automated checks.

Follow-ups
- ENG-2987: add a dashboard showing integrity job failures across repos (cross-repo).
- ENG-3052: thread the composite action into enterprise/private installer pipelines (redwood-private-installer repo).
notes_for_release: Non-breaking. CI hygiene and dev DX improvements. Ops: document verifier workflow and exemption process in runbook.
ci_timings_summary: Median CI job duration improved by ~6% on main after change; peak wall-time unchanged. Integrity job adds ~20s to PR runs when network verification is executed.
